_comment: The ship's armoury and refit (Phase 8, ArmouryRules). 'starting' is what a new campaign's armoury holds, by item key (items.json), and ammunition by 'ammo:<weapon item key>' in rounds. 'goods' is what outposts sell into it: each a price for a pack of 'pack'; 'always' is on every outpost's shelf, the rest on most (which ones, and how dear, from the outpost). 'upgrades' are the ship's, fitted at an outpost a tier at a time: each tier's credits, samples out of the hold ('cargo', resource keys of resources.json) and a part found on a site ('part', one of 'parts', item keys). 'wipe_fee' is the share of the credits a crew lost down a site costs, 'wipe_fee_most' the most it costs.

upgrades.name: Drive
upgrades.blurb: How far the ship crosses between the stars, and how fast it goes.

tiers.says: Crosses to stars 14 light years away.
Crosses 24 light years; quicker in a system.

upgrades.name: Sensors
upgrades.blurb: How far the charts reach, and what the scan of a landing area shows.

tiers.says: Charts 36 light years; the scan shows what lives there.

upgrades.name: Webbing
upgrades.blurb: The crew's belts: room for more small kit each.

tiers.says: A slot more on every belt.
Two slots more on every belt.

upgrades.name: Shuttle
upgrades.blurb: How quickly the shuttle gets off the ground once its launch is started.

tiers.says: Launches 15 seconds after it is started.
Launches 10 seconds after it is started.
